description: Record an affiliate commission event (e.g. when a referred user makes a purchase or renews a subscription). Requires the tracking_code from the original affiliate link. Idempotent -- safe to call multiple times with the same network + network_event_id.

commission_type.description: Type of commission. One of: 'initial', 'recurring', 'one_time'. Defaults to 'recurring'.

metadata.description: Optional extra data (e.g. order ID, plan name).

network.description: The affiliate network that reported this event. One of: 'partnerstack', 'impact', 'direct'.

network_event_id.description: Unique commission event ID from the affiliate network. Used for idempotency.

period_end.description: Billing period end date in ISO 8601 format (optional).

period_start.description: Billing period start date in ISO 8601 format (optional).

tracking_code.description: The tracking code from the affiliate link (returned by generate_tracked_link).

name: record_commission
